reviews.text: Beautiful temple, well kept and well preserved. Its no wonder some nicknamed it as "little potala palace". Some of the buildings opens up to the roof, where one can have a nice view from the top Its a pity we didn't have time to walk down from the temple and immerse ourselves with views from the lake A must visit if you are in shangrila !

Definitely a scenic place to visit. A good walk up the stairs to visit the various temples. Note that the internal bus trip will cost 10 yuan each direction. However, it seems that the return trip will not be checked and thus not necessary to purchase the return trip. Also, those opting to take public bus number 3 to their destination can be pick up from the same place as the internal bus.
Very elegant temple with gold embroidery. To enter as a foreigner, you need to get ticket from online booking platform. The admission includes a bus ride to outskirt of the city.
Do not want to visit Tibet because of the strict procedures? Then visit Songzanlin Monastery instead, because it’s often called the “Little Potala” in Shang-ri La.

Worth the visit. We arrived at the place before 9am and there is already a lot of tour bus parked at the carpark. Suggest to be early to capture photos without the crowd. There are many drivers offering RMB10 to bring you. Don’t be fooled it is fairly short walk up.

We were blessed to have visited the Tibetan Temple and was invited by the Abbot for tea in his guest room. Upon request of Dharma teaching, he stressed on the principle of cause and effect or karma 因果：Good begets good, evil begets evil. We received blessings from the Abbot under his chanting.
Touted as the biggest Tibetan Temple in Yunnan, aside from worship and prayer it attracts many youngsters donning traditional tribes attire/constume for instagramable photos.

As a foreigner, you may get your tickets at the counter and there will be a shuttle bus to bring you to the Monastery. It’s a beautiful sight once you reached there and there are also some costume rental shops and food stalls. At the entrance there will be some touts asking to take you to the top as climbing up to the steep steps could be quite challenging. I spent around 3 hours to explore the temple as it’s quite big. It’s worth the trip!!

I had second thoughts after reading the reviews as it seems quite challenging to get there, but it’s not ! Buy entrance tickets at visitor center , advise to purchase the bus ticket too as it takes you nearer to the site , walking is quite a distance up slope. There are also guided tour with small addition fee . The area look big but when you arrive into the center of the temples . The stairs are manageable , it’s really not that much to do. For people whom can walk for 30 mins they can conquer the stairs, walk slow and stop when needed but definitely manageable. The temples are amazing, huge gold statues, beautiful colours , one of a kind. I enjoyed the visit very much. A must go!

Among all Tibetan buildings i have seen in many places of Himalayas, this one is probably one of the most majestic, especially with the lake where you can sometimes see the reflection of monastery and mountains. Sumstenling / Songzanlin is the circa 300 years old monastery and village mostly founded by the fifth dalai lama. Arriving at the parking area, go get the tickets at the counter: the price is 55 CNY for full access to the monastery and its surroundings (half price if you show a student card); add 20 CNY to take shuttle bus and avoid walking remaining 5 km from the ticket counter to the monastery esplanade; not sure if having your passport is mandatory to get the ticket. A few restaurants, snacks and souvenirs available all around the place Respect the place and refrain taking photos of Boddhisattva statues

Don't buy a ticket, it's just a way to funnel tourists through. It's still a lived-in town, people go in and out all the time, the ticket from the visitor centre is just a scam in my opinion. You can just walk up the road, takes about 15 minutes from the 'visitor centre' to the lake in front of the Monastery. Get up early, go for sunrise and then explore the town before it gets busy. As soon as the buses of tourists come in it ruins the peaceful and authentic experience. The actual temple is beautiful but the less crowded the better.

This place was so worth to visit. We bought the ticket on the spot by cash. The ticket cost ¥58 each person. Wear a proper shoes, because it has plenty of steep stair. And be respect, because it was a Buddhist monastery. And on the top of the monastery, you will have a best view of Shangri-La, snow capped mountain and a beautiful lake Tips : if you stay in the Dukezong Ancient town, you may get the public bus nomor 3. It will lead you directly to the Songzanlin monastery gate. It cost ¥2 each person
Beautiful temple, but there is no direct access to the temple. It is a long walking distance from the bus stop to the temple. It could be challenging for old people or young kids to visit here.
Very nice place to visit. Need to pay entrance fee and transport fee. The road to the temple is very bad and heard of scam inside this temple by the monk. However, I did not meet any on my visit.

Definitely worth a visit. A scared place brings a feeling of inner peace and purifies the soul. Songzanlin Monastery, built in 1679 and situated in the high altitude region over 3,300 meters, is the largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Yunnan province and belongs to the Yellow Hat sect of Tibetan Buddhism of the Gelukpa order of the Dalai Lama. It is also known as “Little Potala Palace” which was built according to the complex of Potala Palace in Lhasa, Tibet. The monastery was partially destroyed in 1959, but since 1981 the monastery buildings have been completely restored and normality prevails. (wikipedia)
Not worth entering the monastery. I think it costs 40 Y. The view from the lake is awesome. Take Bus No 3 from town.

A magical place with a deep sense of spirituality. Coming here, it's easy to forget about the day-to-day hustle and bustle. Walking up the steep staircases to the roof of the temples, you can't help but be awed by the centuries of tradition. This is a sacred place so please respect the customs. Don't forget to take a stroll around the main tourist attractions, you will find a humble abodes that invite a slower pace of life. You might even find a luxry resort to meditate away your worries.
Lots of tourist and youngsters still taking photos while inside. Doesnt seem like a place to play dress up and pictures shouldnt be taken inside. Nice lake beside the monestry.
120 steps to get the most scenic view. You can pay around 32USD to have a cosplay done and take-home photos

Worth while going to if you are in shangri la but it does feel like it is more just a place for tourists to take photos than a monastery. Would recommend walking around the lake to get away from the crowds and can enjoy the beauty of the monastery.

No reservation needed visiting beginning of December… (passport or photo on the phone needed) take bus no 3 from the old town price 2¥ and entrance to songzanlin at the moment is 55¥ because they are making some arrangements..

the attraction is built within a tibetan village which means everyone can go near the attraction, but the management forces tourist to pay to take their coach to enter the premises.... once you are inside there is not much you can see -- most of building are monks' private residences, the halls on the top are, frankly speaking, pretty magnificent but you are not allowed to take pictures inside and you are expected to bow to every gods there is even if you are not buddist.... There are donation boxes everywhere and paid services more accessible than worship places... overall, it's a holy place for buddist but for average tourist, it probably is not worth the price
The local guide who brought us up gave a very candid but detailed commentary of its history.
An old temple And very beautiful The surrounding places were filled with astonishing scenery. Artifacts in the museum Seems to have a lot of spiritual value.

Such Serenity and tranquility , went there before sunset, 1 hour before the ticket closing in September 2024. When the setting sun shines on the temple. It was such a magnificent scene that takes one’s breath away.
Was not super stoked by the visit here purely from a scenic perspective. Lots of cultural significance and definitely worth a visit for that, but not as grand as the three pagodas in Dali

Very unique place with a nice combination of architecture and nature views; good place for people watching too - an interesting mix of art, spirituality and endless horizon to be seen from many places around the site
Highly recommend to have a visit if not have a chance to go Potala Palace in Lhasa.

I wanted to be more impressed by it. As there were many people there who came to take photos, the monastary didnt have that vibration. Monks in gift shops. Another one slumped sloppily watching social media on his phone loudly while another monk was trying to do a blessing for a lady who had bought an amulet. Guishan Park temple had better vibes.

Tibet is too far? Tibet is too pricey? This will cure a little of your Tibetan fever. A small place to compare with Tibet. If you have been to Tibet, you might want to skip this. If you don't, you would want to experience some of the Tibetan culture.
Superb views ...Bit of a hassle to get to. DJI drones don't work here cos it's restricted area.
Tibet religious area. A chance to understand the diversity of culture of Yunnan province.
Worth walking all the way up. If you love taking beautiful photos allocate more time to walk around.
Views are nice, but not worth to go, why? Too many people there, and very disorder, plus bad management of transport arangement. The whole trip are very tiring. Wish I was not there.
Beautiful place yet the overtourism is crazy here. So many shops, souvenirs, alipay scancodes or people taking photos. Its quite sad how such a scenic place loses all its pros due to overtourism.
People just build resident around this historical site. May be they want to be near the heaven

Magnificent monastry, splendid temples on top of the hill, surrounded by village with a beautiful lake in front. Shiny gold roof and ornaments contrast with earthy colours of buildings. Really breathtaking- in part also because of the high altitude. From the entrance, there is a narrow street leading a long stairs to the temples summit. At the top there are a few temples with a common courtyard. In the temples are Buddha statues and lots of ancient looking murals. It probably take a whole day if you want to explore the temple complex, surrounding village and lake. The google default map location marker is wrong. The actual location can be seen with the satellite image switch on at the following coordinates. Songzanling monastry 27.863249°N, 99.704041°E Songsanling entrance 27.861568°N, 99.704819°E

When go for Tibetan Buddha commentary, please make sure you accompanied by someone that able said no and stay together when after bring you go for "fortune teller"/"master", there will promote dzi bead(天珠). And will tell you to not disclose until you back to home.😂 If you purchase and can be return for refund in the center or using local mobile number, install "游云南" in within 30 days refund policy which FOC.

Songzanlin Monastery is one of the most beautiful monastery I have visited. Breathing taking view, hidden behind mountains and very peaceful place. It has the Tibetan vibe and Buddhist monks are walking around and you can interact with them. Most of the monks lives with in the area of Songzanlin Monastery. If you have time try go around the monastery, it is nice walk. You can go inside this monastery during the prayer time, amazing to see the Tibetan Buddhist culture and Buddhism is been practiced. Definitely the place to visit.
Great Temple in Yunnan. The view from the lake is amazing di not miss this spectacular view after visiting this great temple
"mini tibet lhasa" .Ensure you have your oxygen tank with you and need to climb high steps. Magnificent view.

Just a temple with lots of gold ornaments. Our tour guide took us to a tourist trap next to the ticket office. The “monks” sat at a table at the end of the brief “tour” and suggested 999 yuan as a donation.
One can enjoy the tranquility of the temples and be mesmerised by the surrounding scenery, not to mention the fun turning of mighty bell
must try. This street have the old house, beautifull costume. The food are delicious and people are nice too
the air is thin, walking up to the temple need to be slow. once reach the place, it is worth for trying.
Beautiful place, so regret I visited this place when It's under construction, the environment was not perfect.
第一次来到松赞林寺，整体体验非常好。寺庙建筑壮观有特色，讲解也很用心，可以更了解当地藏传文化。天气好时湖面倒影特别美，拍照随手都是大片。推荐慢慢走、慢慢看，真的很治愈。想穿藏族服装的可以参考一下的店铺，才七十元就可以租到衣服&包括全脸化妆。
วิหารใหญ่สามหลัง ภายในดูเคร่งขรึมและศักดิ์สิทธิ์ ต้องนั่งรถบัสของที่นี่เข้าไป และเดินขึ้นอีกหลายร้อยขั้นบันได ถ้าไม่อยากเดิน มีรถชาวบ้านรับ-ส่ง ค่ารถอีกคนละ 50 หยวน

J ai adoré. Compliqué de comprendre comment s y rendre. Nous voulions y allé a pied mais cela semble impossible. Donc, nous sommes allé à la caisse avec un humain qui parle anglais. Même la, nous avions compris qu il fallait layer le bus plus une entrée au "parc" et qu après , nous devrons payer en plus l' entrée au monastère. En fait non ! On a donc payé 50 yuans + 20yuans pour le bus par personne. Une fois sur place pour la visite, on nous a demandé notre ticket. Vous pouvez après faire le tour du lac et voir des yaks .
昆明からはるばる来て本当に良かったです。 青空に映える松賛林寺の美しさはもちろん、麓に連なるチベット家屋とも調和していてずっと眺めていたくなる壮観さでした。 お寺内部は撮影禁止でしたが、チベット仏教の雰囲気を感じることができました。 3kmほど手前にある観光センター？で入場券を買い、そこからバスで来れます。

reviews.authorName: PRAJAK ประจักษ์ ๙
reviews.text: สวยงาม แสดงถึงความยิ่งใหญ่ บันไดสูงชัน ค่อยๆเดิน หายใจลึกๆ ให้ความเคารพกับสถานที่ ด้านใน วิหาร งดถ่าย รูป

《松贊林景區》 🌈在香格里拉的松贊林也是很多人會參訪的地方（雖然樓梯的接觸不少）。 🌈從遊客中心需要購票，然後再去搭園區的巴士前往三座藏族寺廟的地方才開始步行拾級而上， 🌈由左而右依依進入三個大殿，而且也是由左而右進入繞一圈後出門再到下一座大殿。 🌈進入殿中喇嘛會用已受祝福的經卷板在頭上輕拍並送一個木質手環，我們可隨喜供奉以現金或電子支付（好法子）。 🌈最後有個4人🈴裡旋轉的經輪（會頭暈），結束之後即可原路下階梯回到入口處等候園區巴士。 🌈印象深刻的是接近階梯最頂端的那面黃色的不平整大大的牆，有不少人取景。 🌈還有，今天幸運看到烏鴉，在藏族烏鴉是喜鳥喔！
ถ่ายจากด้านนอก วัดซงจ้างหลิง เป็นวัดทิเบตที่สวยงามมากเดินรอบทะเลสาปหน้าวัด พร้อมกับถ่ายแสงเช้า หนึ่งใน hilight ของแถบนี้เรยคะ

Ein wundervoller Ort. Vom Eingang aus fahren Shuttlebusse für 20 Yuan extra, diese sollte man nehmen, der Fußweg lohnt sich nicht! Vor Ort kann man im Main Temple die Treppen hochsteigen, dies ist etwas versteckt aber die Aussicht lohnt sich wirklich!

18년전에는 한가하고 조용한 사찰이었는데 지금은 중국에서 가장 사진찍기 좋은 명소가 되었네요. 입구에서 셔틀과 입장권을 묶어서 판매합니다. 예전에는 호수길따라 걸어서 들어간것이 좋았는데 지금은 버스로 바로 송찬림사까지 들어가네요. 버스에서 내리면 빵차로 정상까지 타고가라고 호객을 하는데 계단올라가면서 보는 체험도 좋으니 계단 천천히 올라가시길 추천합니다 유튜브 허여사의 여행일기에 편집해서 올렸으니 참고하세요

[English below] Một nơi rất tuyệt vời mà tôi đã từng viếng thăm. Nằm ở độ cao hơn 3000 mét và có những nét đặc trưng của văn hoá Tây Tạng mang đến cảm giác thiêng liêng và tĩnh lặng đến lạ thường. Tuy nhiên khi đến đây cần chuẩn bị sức khoẻ thật tốt, uống thuốc chống sốc độ cao và lúc nào cũng nên chuẩn bị bình thở oxy, đặc biệt từ 10h tối đến 03h sáng A wonderful place that I have ever visited. Located at an altitude of over 3000 meters and has the characteristics of Tibetan culture, it brings a feeling of sacredness and extraordinary tranquility. However, when coming here, you need to prepare your health very well, take anti-high altitude shock medicine and always prepare an oxygen tank, especially from 10pm to 3am.
วัดธิเบต พี่ไม่ต้องไปไกลถึงทิเบต ก็ได้มีโอกาส นมัสการสิ่งศักดิ์สิทธิ์ ได้ มีสีสันที่สวยงาม มีมุมถ่ายรูปเยอะ แต่ภายในวัดไม่อนุญาตให้ถ่าย

reviews.authorName: พรสวรรค์ วัฒนวรวิทย์
reviews.text: สวยงามมากค่ะ. ภายในยิ่งอลังกาล แต่เค้าห้ามถ่ายรูป เลยไม่มีให้ดู อยากดูต้องไปเองสักครั้งนึงค่ะ
รู้สึกเลื่อมใส สงบเย็น เข้าในวัดแล้วรู้สึกจิตใจเบิกบาน ผ่อนคลาย ได้รับพลังดีๆจากองค์ลามะ รูปเคารพยิ่งใหญ่งดงามดั่งภาพวาด แต่องค์ล้วนเหลืองอร่ามงดงามเป็นที่สุด

วัดลามะซงจ้านหลิน (Songzanlin) วัดใหญ่ที่สำคัญของเมืองแชงกรีล่า (Shangri-La) มณฑลยูนาน ตั้งอยู่บนภูเขาที่ระดับความสูงกว่า 3,000 เมตรเหนือระดับน้ำทะเล สถาปัตยกรรมที่มีเอกลักษณ์ทำให้รู้สึกตื่นตาตื่นใจมาก แต่ก็เสียดายที่ไม่อนุญาตให้ถ่ายภาพด้านในอาคารเพราะมีความโดดเด่นเฉพาะและอลังการงานสร้าง และเรื่องราวของพุทธศาสนาแบบมหายาน . ทั้งความงามของเจ้าแม่กวนอิมในปางแบบผู้ชายตามแบบธิเบต หากทำบุญกับลามะที่นี่เราจะได้รับประคำข้อมือ 1 เส้น หรือจะทำบุญด้วยการจุดเทียนบูชาก็ได้ . มีคนไทยหลายคนวางเงินบาทไว้ก็ไม่มีปัญหา วัดนี้มีอายุเก่าแก่กว่า 300 ปี สถาปัตยกรรมภายในวัดถอดแบบมาจาก #พระราชวังโปตาลา (#Potala) ในกรุงลาซา (Lhasa) ทิเบต ที่นี่จึงมีฉายาว่าเป็นพระราชวังโปตาลาน้อย (The Little Potala Palace) . ทุกวันนี้การขึ้นด้านบนเราต้องใช้รถโดยสารของทางวัดขึ้นไป . จานั้นเดินเท้าขึ้นบันไดราวๆ 200 ขั้นสู่ที่ตั้งวัด แต่ถ้าไม่ไหว ก็จะมีรถรับจ้างของชาวบ้านคิดราคาคนละ 50 หยวน(ไปกลับ) พาขึ้นไป แต่ต้องสื่อสารกันให้ดีถึงการมารับลง วัดนี้หากได้เดินชมและมีผู้รู้ช่วยแนะนำด้วยจะดีมากๆ

Điểm đến của tâm linh, các bạn nên ăn mặt cho phù hợp, và có thể thỉnh lộc về, một nơi đáng để tới và cầu an cho gia đình, tâm nhẹ nhàn khi vừa ra về, cảm thấy an yên, bạn nào cơ địa yếu nên nghe theo hướng dẫn mua oxy và uốn nước thuốc vì trên này cao oxy rất thấp so với những nơi khác.

วัดซงจ้านหลิน นั่ง Taxi ไปไม่ไกลมากประมาณ10¥ กว่า จากเมือง ถึงแล้วซื้อบัตรเข้าคนละ 75¥ หรือประมาณเกือบ400บาท แล้วนั่งบัสของที่นี่ต่อเข้าไปประมาณ5นาที พอลงแล้วก็จะเป็นทางเข้าวัด ซึ่งตัววัดอยู่บนเขาอีกที ก็มีคนมาขายว่านั่งรถขึ้นไปมั้ยคนละ 20¥ ถ้าไปกลับก็ 30¥ ดูไวๆละว่าเดินขึ้นน่าจะเหนื่อย เลยนั่งขาขึ้นแล้วค่อยเดินลงเอาดีกว่า เขาก็มีคนขับรถขึ้นไปส่งข้างบน แล้วก็เดินเที่ยวชมวัดเอา เป็นวัดธิเบตที่ดูเก่าแก่และขลัง ทัวร์มาลงที่นี้ทุกกลุ่มที่มาแชงกลีล่าเลย เขาก็จะมีเล่าๆประวัติความเป็นมาต่างๆของวัด ส่วนเรานั้น มาดูๆเที่ยวๆถ่ายรูปอย่างเดียว ไม่ได้เข้าใจอะไรกะเขาเลย นี่สินะขอเสียของการมาเที่ยวเอง มีมุมถ่ายรูปเยอะนะ มีคนแต่งตัวแนวธิเบตมาใส่ถ่ายรูปเยอะอยู่เหมือนกันวัดที่นี่ที่แตกต่างจากไทย ทุกวัดของจีนใส่รองเท้าเข้าวัดได้อะ ตั้งแต่สิบสองปันนาละ แต่วัดเขาก็ยังสะอาดนะ ข้างในวัดไม่ให้ถ่ายรูป ถ่ายแต่ข้างนอก ชอบวิวที่นี่อีกอย่างคือเห็นภูเขาหิมะด้วย สวยงาม ข้างบนจะมีโบสถ์3โบสถ์ใหญ่ๆ ข้างในก็ไม่เหมือนกัน มีที่นั่งเหมือนให้พระมานั่งสวด เดินอยู่ประมาณชม.กว่าก็เริ่มเดินลงละ บันไดขึ้นลงค่อนข้างชัน

Tu viện Songzanlin hay còn được biết đến với tên gọi “Tùng Tán Lâm”( 松赞林), là quần thể chùa Phật giáo Tây Tạng có quy mô lớn. Tu viện được Đạt Lai Lạt Ma thứ 5 cho xây dựng theo nguyên mẫu thu nhỏ của cung điện Potala, khu phức hợp có hình dáng của một tháp canh Tây Tạng gồm 5 tầng tương ứng với 5 cổng. Vào thời kỳ đỉnh cao của Phật giáo tu viện có khoảng 2000 tu sĩ, cho đến nay còn khoảng 700 tu sĩ sống trong chùa và quanh khu vực. Với lối kiến trúc độc đáo và quy mô đồ sộ tu viện đã trở thành điểm du lịch văn hóa thu hút du khách. Nổi bật nhất là thiền viện nằm ở khu vực trung tâm trên đỉnh đồi, được chia thành hai khu Zhacang và Jikang, bao quanh là những điện nhỏ hơn, nơi những tu sĩ trẻ sinh sống và học tập. Thiền viện chính cũng là căn phòng rộng lớn nhất, bên trong có 108 cây cột lớn, được thắp sáng bởi vô số đèn dầu vô cùng lung linh. Du khách không được chụp ảnh bên trong. Tu viện đang trong giai đoạn trùng tu, đường vào khá gồ gề và hẹp, lối đi chính lên thiền viện đang sửa chữa phải đi vòng. Kiến trúc chính của tu viện rất đẹp, nhưng những khối nhà ở của các tu sĩ xung quanh rất lộn xộn làm kiến trúc tổng thể bị méo mó.

【噶丹松赞林寺】 噶丹·松赞林寺是云南省规模最大的藏传佛教寺院，在整个藏区都有着举足轻重的地位，被誉为“小布达拉宫”。 该寺又称归化寺，距香格里拉古城5公里，是一座古镇规模的古堡群建筑。于公元1679年（藏历第十一绕迥阴土羊年）兴建，公元1681年（阴铁鸡年）竣工。 交通 香格里拉县城长征路上乘3路公交（票价1元）或中巴车（2元）可以直达，车程30分钟，停车场就在寺门对面，打车12元 普通票:原价55，今年半价27.5 观光车20往返，路程两公里走路半小时 讲解15每人，在寺门口等待凑够人数就行 开放时间：08:00-18:00

「小布達拉宮」松贊林寺，是雲南最大藏傳佛教寺廟。位於雲南香格里拉，全名為噶丹·松贊林寺。 松贊林寺始建於1681年（清康熙二十年），距今有300多年歷史，由五世達賴喇嘛奏請康熙帝赦准修建，後來，雍正帝給寺廟賜名「歸化寺」，是雲南省規模最大的藏傳佛教寺廟。
